findings: The latest revision retains perfect attribute-revealing tests and discounted rewards. Appendices A/C discuss unreliable priors; Appendix D compares against test-first and prior-aware code-first, without significant superiority to every baseline in every cost regime.

verified_code_facts.fact: unit_test_run returns true formatting values directly from csv_info.meta_info; it does not infer them by running a fallible diagnostic.
compute_discounted_reward multiplies correctness by supplied unit-test and code-attempt discount factors.
Learned-prior mode calls predict_one(filename); oracle mode is separate.

our_inference: A future comparator should use pre-acquisition estimates learned on development data and pay for their computation. It must not import true bug causes, reference patches, or future diagnostic values. No claim that imperfections or cost-awareness alone establish novelty.
